newsitem.title: INDIA: Range of 100-120 yen/dlr is reasonable -- Toyoda.
newsitem.headline: Range of 100-120 yen/dlr is reasonable -- Toyoda.

text.p: A range of 100-120 yen to the dollar is reasonable, Toyota Motor Corp chairman Shoichiro Toyoda said on Friday.

Toyoda, who is here at the head of a Japan Federation of Economic Organisations (Keidanren) delegation, told a luncheon meeting: "With the yen at 80 (to the dollar), I believe the yen was overvalued. That is more than what reflects the Japanese true strength.
"I would say the reasonable range would be between 100 to 120 yen to a dollar."

"The exchange rate is determined based on what are called fundamentals, the relative economic strength that the country might have. For manufacturers it is not desirable when the yen-dollar exchange rate fluctuates all of a sudden dramatically," Toyoda told the meeting organised by the Confederation of Indian Industry.
"So it is desirable that the exchange rate of the Japanese yen vis-a-vis the dollar not move so dramatically within a short period of time," he added.
